citations.quote:
[name="菲亚梅塔"]忘记了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]你那边怎么样？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="菲亚梅塔")]好消息，炸弹已经就位。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="菲亚梅塔")]坏消息，我怕它们的威力不足以摧毁全部的锁定装置，把剩下的榴弹也都安上去了……
[name="菲亚梅塔"]所以，我现在已经没有任何弹药去对付这些怪物了。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_snarl_1", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.7)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="蒙恩的生物A"]（光环急速闪烁）
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="蒙恩的生物B"]（连续不断的祷告声）
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]喂，菲亚梅塔，启动吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_357_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]等等，蕾缪安那边还没有消息，如果锁定装置没能及时解除防护，我们所有的炸药就都浪费了……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_heartratemonitor", volume=0.8, loop=true, channel="h")]
[StopSound(channel="h", fadetime=6)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]爆破倒计时，一分钟！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_357_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]你？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
计时器的声音从菲亚梅塔的手中传出，蒙恩的生物纷纷停下了祷告，他们像是预感到了会发生什么，发疯了似的向她扑了过来。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_monsterroar", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.5)]
[Delay(time=0.7)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_wolflordclaw",volume=0.7)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrowshot")]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrowtarget", volume=0.6,delay=0.3)]
[PlaySound(key="$bodyfalldown2", volume=1,delay=0.8)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_sandnmlfts", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=1)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_332_archet#6",focus="m")]
[name="席德佳"]……
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Background(image="bg_black",screenadapt="coverall")]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
席德佳摸向箭壶，里面已经空了。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_heartratemonitor", volume=0.8, loop=true, channel="fs")]
[StopSound(channel="fs", fadetime=4.5)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[stopmusic(fadetime=1.5)]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]倒计时，五十秒！
[name="？？？"]抱歉，各位，希望我没有来迟！
[Dialog]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_electrcwhlchrrll",volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot]
[image(image="61_i19",screenadapt="coverall",fadetime=0)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$drift", volume=0.5)]
[PlayMusic(intro="$m_bat_act26side_intro", key="$m_bat_act26side_loop", volume=0.6)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2.5, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
车轮急刹，在地面激荡起烟尘。车手拧转轮椅，右手在同一时间举起了铳，她的长发在空中肆意飞舞。
[name="莫斯提马"]时间刚刚好！
[name="蕾缪安"]菲亚梅塔，莫斯提马，我们的配合还是那么默契！
[name="蕾缪安"]哈哈，你俩肯定猜不到，从第七厅一路突围到这里，我把自己轮椅竞速射击赛的纪录突破了多少！
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_heartratemonitor", volume=0.8, loop=true, channel="fs1")]
[StopSound(channel="fs1", fadetime=3)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]倒计时，四十秒！
